items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: Doc Sushone once had me take a picture of it.

ctx.x: No that was the West End roof. They had one out there. West End. Yeah. Well while I was playing at the Biennale Jules Vaduc I had originally been with Jules' band you see. Yeah. And we got burnt out at the Slipper. And two weeks after that I parked in front of the Slipper. I parked in front of the Slipper. And went to the show. And they stole my automobile. While I was at the show. That was two weeks after the fire. No it never did get back. Never got to this day. So man I was all swelled up. So we were…
Doc Sushone once had me take a picture of it. And he told me it was the Biennville Roof. No no.
